title: what to prepare before the delivery?
label: multiples

posts.body:
hi there.

 i am expecting twins in June/09 and wondering what to get before the delivery to welcome babies.

 thinking to get twin stoller, baby bath, babybed etc...

 but to be honest, i have no idea what to buy....

 could any twin parents advice me what to get before the delivery??? 

 Thank you so much!!:thanks

posts.body:
first off, what one person loves, another might find useless.

a lot will depend on breast vs bottle feeding but generally:

onesies

crib/cot/bassinet (whatever it is you want the babies to sleep in)

bedding

nappies

those are the ONLY ESSENTIALS.

however, you may also wish to get:

breastfeeding pillow

bottles

steriliser

pacifiers

baby bath (you can actually bathe babies in the regular bath or even the kitchen sink, you don't really need a bath for htem)

change table (a bed, sofa, or even the floor can work just as well)

bouncy chair/swing

baby powder

soft sponge for cleaning

thermometer (better to have one before you need it)

cotton balls

wet wipes

nursing tops (for you)

nursing bras (for you)

bra pads 

maternity pads

some kind of blankets/sheets/wraps

sling

carseats

stroller (that lay flat for babies)

newborns don't really need toys... they may find something interesting by the time they get to 3 months or so.

posts.body:
Hi there,

I have twins myself and I am also co-chairman of Moms Of Multiples here in Hong Kong. We organize lunches, dinners, play dates and parties (Halloween, Xmas, Easter), etc. 

You can find more about MoMs here, membership is $350 a year.

http://moms-hongkong.com/

We also have a Yahoo group for pregnant members. We had 2 delivering this month, 1 due with trips any moment and 2 more in April / May (but they're on bed rest unfortunately).

Please pm me and I can highly recommend signing up!

posts.body:
Hello

I've not been around for a while as my twins came early! They were born on 27th Dec at 31 weeks and 6 days weighing 1.6 and 1.9Kg. Both are doing really well our little girl came home at 35 weeks and our boy at 38 weeks.

In response to this thread we opted not to buy a twin buggy. When I'm out on my own I have a quinny zapp and a maxi cosy car seat and a baby bjorn - this is working really well for me and means I'm not housebound!
